title: The 3 Best Deep Fryers for French Fries
h1: The 3 Best Deep Fryers for French Fries
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for deep fryers for french fries, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at deep fryers for french fries using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cuisinart CDF-200P1 Professional Deep Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: 1-gallon removable stainless steel oil container, 1800W immersion heating element, 2.3-pound food capacity.
strengths: 1800W element recovers fast between the first and second fry of a double-fry batch
2.3-pound capacity fries a full family-size batch in fewer rounds
Viewing window lets you watch color develop on the second fry without lifting the lid
Removable oil container makes it easy to strain and reuse oil between fry sessions
limitations: Single basket means sequential batches for very large amounts
Bulkier housing than a compact dual-well unit
features: Adjustable temperature dial with viewing window

products.name: Hamilton Beach Professional Style Electric Deep Fryer 35036
products.blurb: Key specs: 4.5-liter / 19-cup oil capacity, 1800W immersed heating element, Two baskets included.
strengths: Two baskets let you run a first-fry batch and second-fry batch side by side
1800W element matches the Cuisinart on recovery speed
4.5-liter capacity is the largest on this list, good for entertaining
Removable, dishwasher-safe heating element and tank
limitations: No digital timer for tracking the two fry stages
Two baskets to store and clean instead of one

products.name: Presto Dual Daddy Electric Deep Fryer
products.blurb: Key specs: Dual-well design with removable divider, 1500W element, Automatic thermostat.
strengths: Dual wells let you first-fry one side while second-frying the other
Automatic thermostat holds a steady temperature without manual adjustment
Compact enough for daily countertop use without dominating the space
limitations: 1500W element recovers slower than the 1800W Cuisinart and Hamilton Beach
8-cup capacity limits batches to a half pound or so per well
No viewing window, so checking color means lifting the lid

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
